{{Quote|Jedi Saar, I suspect I know what you are experiencing.''"<br />"''What have you done with Master Cilghal?''"<br />"''I know how this conversation progresses. There is no point to it. You cannot be reasoned with.|Cilghal and Saar, shortly before their duel|<ref name="lash" />}}
A '''duel''' took place in the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] had begun to contract a [[Force psychosis]] that caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors. The [[Chev]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Sothais Saar]] developed the psychosis while reporting to the [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State's]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Wynn Dorvan]]. After he fled the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], Saar was confronted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]] in the Senate Plaza. The two entered into a brief [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]], during which Cilghal overpowered Saar and knocked him unconscious. Saar was then taken into custody in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|You're probably wondering what I've done with the real Wynn Dorvan.|Wynn Dorvan, to Sothais Saar, upon realizing that Saar had developed the psychosis|<ref name="lash" />}}
Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] began to contract a [[Force psychosis]] that caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors. The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|decided]] to deal with the issue by [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encasing]] the afflicted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], much to the chagrin of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Chev]] Jedi Knight [[Sothais Saar]] developed the psychosis while he was giving a report to Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s personal [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Wynn Dorvan]], in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When Dorvan realized what had happened to Saar, he told the Jedi that he was unarmed, and Saar decided to flee. Dorvan attempted to lock the building down, but with the [[Force speed/Legends|aid]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Saar was able to escape before the order could be enacted.<ref name="lash" />

==The duel==
[[File:Cilghalcolor.jpg|thumb|right|125px|Jedi Master Cilghal]]
{{Quote|He ran into Jedi Master Cilghal, dueled with her briefly, and was flattened like a bug.|Natasi Daala|<ref name="lash" />}}
In the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] outside the building, Saar was quickly confronted by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]], who knew from past experiences with Jedi affected by the psychosis that Saar could not be reasoned with. They began to [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]], and Saar quickly took the offensive, but Cilghal did not fall for his feints or his attempts to get her off-balance. Finding himself overpowered, Saar attempted to back-flip away from her, but the Jedi Master [[Telekinesis/Legends|pushed]] him in midair, slamming him against a nearby building and knocking him unconscious. The Chev was taken into custody in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]], and Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] prepared to take him offworld to keep him safe from Galactic Alliance persecution.<ref name="lash" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The Coruscant Security officers I dispatched to the Jedi Temple are there now and have issued an order to the Jedi. They must turn over Jedi Saar within the hour or there will be consequences.|Natasi Daala, to Wynn Dorvan|<ref name="lash" />}}
The Galactic Alliance soon dispatched [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to force the Jedi Order to hand over the psychotic Knight, but the Jedi refused. Daala then decided that she needed to teach the Jedi a lesson and hired [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to [[Raid on the New Jedi Temple|attack]] the Jedi Temple. The Jedi suffered no casualties, but the raid crippled Temple communications and coordination, and a subsequent Galactic Alliance [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] on the Temple prevented Solo from escaping with Saar.<ref name="lash" />

==Behind the scenes==
The duel first appeared in the fourth [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] novel&mdash;and author [[Aaron Allston]]'s second installment in the series&mdash;''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', which was released in [[2010]].<ref name="lash" />
